WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, command_line,
    childproc_name, filemod_name, regmod_name, object, access, raw_event_type,
    event_record_id, event_id, source_stream, source_row_id,
    CASE
      WHEN childproc_name IS NOT NULL OR raw_event_type LIKE '%childproc%' THEN 'childproc'
      WHEN filemod_name IS NOT NULL OR raw_event_type LIKE '%filemod%' THEN 'filemod'
      WHEN regmod_name IS NOT NULL OR raw_event_type LIKE '%regmod%' OR object LIKE '%\\Run%' OR object LIKE '%\\RunOnce%' THEN 'regmod'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS edge_type
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE (
      (time BETWEEN '2022-07-16 15:03:55' AND '2022-07-16 15:03:57' AND pid = 2360)
      OR (time BETWEEN '2022-07-16 15:05:29' AND '2022-07-16 15:05:31' AND pid = 5504)
    )
    AND (pname LIKE '%reg.exe%' OR process_name LIKE '%reg.exe%' OR command_line LIKE '%reg.exe%')
    AND (
      childproc_name IS NOT NULL OR filemod_name IS NOT NULL OR regmod_name IS NOT NULL
      OR raw_event_type LIKE '%childproc%' OR raw_event_type LIKE '%filemod%' OR raw_event_type LIKE '%regmod%'
      OR object LIKE '%\\Run%' OR object LIKE '%\\RunOnce%'
    )
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pid, edge_type,
        CASE WHEN edge_type='regmod' THEN source_stream ELSE printf('%s:%s:%s', coalesce(childproc_name,''), coalesce(filemod_name,''), coalesce(regmod_name, object, '')) END,
        CASE WHEN edge_type='regmod' THEN coalesce(regmod_name, object, '') ELSE '' END
      ORDER BY time, event_record_id, source_row_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM candidates
)
SELECT
  time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, command_line,
  childproc_name, filemod_name, coalesce(regmod_name, object) AS "regmod_name/object",
  access, raw_event_type, event_record_id, event_id, source_stream, source_row_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY time, pid, edge_type, source_stream, event_record_id, source_row_id;
